data.one_liner: Dio interceptor and network logger for Alice network inspector UI
data.what_it_does: Integrates the Dio HTTP client with the Alice inspector plugin. Allows you to log, inspect, and debug Dio requests and responses inside a native Flutter UI.
use_when: You use the Dio package for network requests in Flutter
You need a visual in-app tool to inspect and debug HTTP traffic
avoid_when: You are not using the Dio HTTP client
You do not need a visual network logger in your app
strengths: Provides a dedicated native Flutter UI for debugging network calls
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Alice package and Dio
Adds overhead and debug tooling dependencies to the codebase
data.setup_notes: Add Alice and alice_dio to dependencies, create AliceDioAdapter, add it to Alice and to Dio interceptors.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need the HTTP client functionality without the Alice UI inspector.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the basic Dart HTTP client instead of Dio.
